submittedParameters.prompt: EXACT CANVAS SCALE LOCK: retain Image1 head crown, face, shoulders, upper-body outline and full bow at their exact original coordinates and dimensions. Do not zoom or fill the margins. Only lower-body joint edits. Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image1 as ONE independent transparent RGBA run/NW/12 frame. Image2 is the primary approved bright clean rounded hand-painted style, NOT UI content. Preserve precisely the upper body, head/hair silhouette, ornaments, face, camera, figure scale, bow, hands, sleeves, torso, right shoulder quiver, canvas placement and full original materials. Anatomical LEFT hand holds one complete long bamboo bow, RIGHT hand empty. Change only connected hips/knees/ankles/boots and minimally necessary shorts/lower hem. Keep rear three-quarter facing UPPER-LEFT NW, shoes follow that travel direction without sideways ankle turnout. RIGHT support pair C. Correct leg identities to Image3: the FAR RIGHT thigh connects to the rear supporting boot, and NEAR LEFT thigh drives forward with raised knee. Do not retain a mistaken near-left supporting thigh. It is too far back: flex its knee and bring the boot about HALF A BOOT WIDTH toward screen-left, toe near normalized x535,y950, heel around x600,y937, a near-rear ground band. Heel LOW, whole sole/forefoot supports, no airborne sole facing viewer. Near LEFT knee remains bent swung forward at screen-left with boot lifted. Second near-rear right support, softly changing knee/ankle rather than a duplicate. Coordinates are normalized to a1024 canvas, same fixed composition as input. Four successive ground bands are forward landing, under body, near-rear support, far-rear push; each has two truly independent poses. Never fake this by mirroring, duplicate frames, whole-character translation, scaling, interpolation, straight locked knees or sideways splayed toes. Ground is invisible: no floor, cast shadow, text, marks or effects. Retain true transparency and full unclipped bow/hair/boots. Native resolution at least1024. Highest visual finish. Image3 is ONLY a lower-leg identity/overlap guide: the NEAR anatomical LEFT thigh reaches forward at screen-left with raised bent knee and free boot, the FAR anatomical RIGHT thigh extends backward toward screen-right as support. Respect this hip assignment, independently draw a different in-between pose on Image1 with shorter stride for11/12 or continued support for14. DO NOT copy Image3 body, head, hands, canvas placement, or entire legs. Keep Image1 upper body exactly.
